about: Hongmen film, sound cues. Every cue is tied to a NAMED beat (see cuesheet.py); the mixer (mix.py) resolves the names from beats.json. Where a segment is animated, the cue is tied to the PICTURE's own beat: PIC.A.x = segA.ts T.x, PIC.B.x = segB.ts B.x (dump_beats.mjs reads those tables), so the sound lands where the picture lands; segments C to E are not animated yet and still use HIT / TAG / BEAT of beats.ts (HIT.x = the first frame of a caption GROUP, not of the word). Levels (rel) are dB against the narration's loud syllables, as in the Arthur film: spot effects -8 to -16, beds -24 to -28.
